search.query: index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625) | stats count
index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4624 OR EventID=4624) | stats count

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4624 OR EventID=4624) (LogonType=10 OR LogonType="10" OR Logon_Type=10 OR Logon_Type="10" OR LogonType="RemoteInteractive") | stats count

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625) (LogonType=10 OR LogonType="10" OR Logon_Type=10 OR Logon_Type="10" OR LogonType="RemoteInteractive") | stats count

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625) | eval src_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address,SourceNetworkAddress,IpAddress,Client_Address,src_ip) | where src_ip!="-" AND isnotnull(src_ip) | bucket span=5m _time | stats count by _time src_ip | where count >= 5 | stats count as alert_count
index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4740 OR EventID=4740) | stats count

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625) | eval src_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address,SourceNetworkAddress,IpAddress,Client_Address,src_ip) | where src_ip!="-" AND isnotnull(src_ip) | stats dc(src_ip) as unique_ips
index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4672 OR EventID=4672) | stats count
index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625) | timechart span=5m count as "Failed Logins"
index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4624 OR EventID=4624) | timechart span=5m count as "Successful Logins"

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625) | eval src_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address,SourceNetworkAddress,IpAddress,Client_Address,src_ip) | where src_ip!="-" AND src_ip!="::1" AND src_ip!="127.0.0.1" AND src_ip!="localhost" AND isnotnull(src_ip) | stats count by src_ip | sort -count | head 10

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4624 OR EventID=4624) NOT user="ANONYMOUS LOGON" | eval src_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address,SourceNetworkAddress,IpAddress,Client_Address,src_ip) | where src_ip!="-" AND src_ip!="::1" AND src_ip!="127.0.0.1" AND src_ip!="localhost" AND isnotnull(src_ip) | stats count by src_ip | sort -count | head 10

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4624 OR EventID=4624) (LogonType=10 OR LogonType="10" OR Logon_Type=10 OR Logon_Type="10" OR LogonType="RemoteInteractive") | eval user=coalesce(TargetUserName,SubjectUserName,Account_Name,user) | eval src_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address,SourceNetworkAddress,IpAddress,Client_Address,src_ip) | eval logon_type=coalesce(LogonType,Logon_Type) | table _time user src_ip host logon_type | rename _time as "Time" user as "User" src_ip as "Source IP" host as "Host" logon_type as "Logon Type" | sort - _time

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625) | eval user=coalesce(TargetUserName,SubjectUserName,Account_Name,user) | eval src_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address,SourceNetworkAddress,IpAddress,Client_Address,src_ip) | eval reason=coalesce(Failure_Reason,Status,SubStatus) | eval logon_type=coalesce(LogonType,Logon_Type) | table _time user src_ip reason logon_type host | rename _time as "Time" user as "User" src_ip as "Source IP" reason as "Failure Reason" logon_type as "Logon Type" host as "Host" | sort - _time

panel.title: BRUTE FORCE DETECTION — >5 Attempts per 5 Min

search.query: index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625) | eval src_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address,IpAddress,Client_Address,src_ip) | where isnotnull(src_ip) AND src_ip!="-" AND src_ip!="::1" AND src_ip!="127.0.0.1" | bucket span=5m _time | stats count values(host) as host by _time src_ip | where count > 5 | rename _time as "Window" src_ip as "Source IP" count as "Attempt Count" host as "Target Host" | sort - "Attempt Count"

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4648 OR EventID=4648) | eval user=coalesce(SubjectUserName,TargetUserName,Account_Name) | eval src_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address,SourceNetworkAddress,IpAddress,Client_Address,src_ip) | eval target=coalesce(TargetServerName,TargetInfo) | table _time user src_ip target host | rename _time as "Time" user as "User" src_ip as "Source IP" target as "Target Host" host as "Host" | sort - _time

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4672 OR EventID=4672) | eval user=coalesce(SubjectUserName,Account_Name,user) | eval privs=coalesce(PrivilegeList,Privilege_List) | table _time user privs host | rename _time as "Time" user as "User" privs as "Privileges" host as "Host" | sort - _time

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational") (EventCode=1 OR EventID=1) | search (Image="*powershell.exe" OR Image="*pwsh.exe") | timechart span=5m count as "PowerShell Executions"

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational") (EventCode=1 OR EventID=1) | search Image="*powershell.exe" OR Image="*cmd.exe" OR Image="*mimikatz*" OR Image="*wscript.exe" OR Image="*mshta.exe" OR Image="*certutil.exe" | eval proc_name=mvindex(split(Image,"\\"),-1) | stats count by proc_name | sort -count

panel.title: CREDENTIAL ACCESS — EventCode 4776 NTLM Auth Failures

search.query: index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4776 OR EventID=4776) | eval user=coalesce(TargetUserName,SubjectUserName,Account_Name,user) | eval workstation=coalesce(Workstation,WorkstationName) | eval result=coalesce(ErrorCode,Status,"Unknown") | table _time user workstation result host | rename _time as "Time" user as "User" workstation as "Workstation" result as "Error Code" host as "Host" | sort - _time

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4624 OR EventID=4624) (LogonType=3 OR LogonType="3" OR Logon_Type=3 OR Logon_Type="3") | eval pkg=coalesce(AuthenticationPackageName,Authentication_Package) | where like(pkg,"%NTLM%") | eval user=coalesce(TargetUserName,SubjectUserName,Account_Name,user) | eval src_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address,SourceNetworkAddress,IpAddress,Client_Address,src_ip) | where src_ip!="-" AND isnotnull(src_ip) | table _time user src_ip pkg host | rename _time as "Time" user as "User" src_ip as "Source IP" pkg as "Auth Package" host as "Host" | sort - _time

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") | eval Severity=case( EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625, "Critical", EventCode=4740 OR EventID=4740, "High", EventCode=4648 OR EventID=4648, "High", EventCode=4672 OR EventID=4672, "High", EventCode=4624 OR EventID=4624, "Low", EventCode=4776 OR EventID=4776, "Medium", 1=1, "Info") | stats count by Severity | eval sort_order=case(Severity="Critical",1,Severity="High",2,Severity="Medium",3,Severity="Low",4,1=1,5) | sort sort_order | fields - sort_order

index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625) | eval src_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address,SourceNetworkAddress,IpAddress,Client_Address,src_ip) | where src_ip!="-" AND isnotnull(src_ip) | iplocation src_ip | where isnotnull(lat) AND isnotnull(lon) | geostats latfield=lat longfield=lon count

panel.title: LIVE EVENT STREAM — All Critical Activity

search.query: (index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625 OR EventCode=4624 OR EventID=4624 OR EventCode=4740 OR EventID=4740 OR EventCode=4648 OR EventID=4648 OR EventCode=4672 OR EventID=4672)) OR (index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational") (EventCode=1 OR EventID=1)) | eval user=coalesce(TargetUserName,SubjectUserName,Account_Name,user) | eval src_ip=coalesce(Source_Network_Address,SourceNetworkAddress,IpAddress,Client_Address,src_ip) | eval logon_type=coalesce(LogonType,Logon_Type) | eval Severity=case( EventCode=4625 OR EventID=4625, "Critical", EventCode=4740 OR EventID=4740, "High", EventCode=4648 OR EventID=4648, "High", EventCode=4672 OR EventID=4672, "High", match(lower(coalesce(Image,"")),"powershell|mimikatz|mshta"), "High", EventCode=4624 OR EventID=4624, "Low", 1=1, "Medium") | eval proc=coalesce(Image,"N/A") | eval cmd=coalesce(CommandLine,"N/A") | table _time Severity host user src_ip EventCode logon_type proc cmd | rename _time as "Time" Severity as "Severity" host as "Host" user as "User" src_ip as "Source IP" EventCode as "Event" logon_type as "Logon Type" proc as "Process" cmd as "Command" | sort - _time
index=main (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Security") (EventCode=4740 OR EventID=4740)
